Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: Begin String Y FIX.4.2 (Always unencrypted, must be first field in message)

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Body Length Y (Always unencrypted, must be second field in message)

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Msg Type Y Defines message type. (Always unencrypted, must be third field in message)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Msg Seq Num Y Message sequence number

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Poss Dup Flag N Always required for retransmitted messages, whether prompted by the sending system or as the result of a resend request.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: Sender Comp ID Y Assigned value used to identify firm sending message.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sender Sub ID N Send Sub ID has to be a known BIDS Trading OMS/EMS user if provided Pass through tag

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Sending Time Y This must always be within 60 seconds of the time BIDS Trading receives it, or it will be rejected.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Target Comp ID Y This is the assigned value used to identify the receiving firm. Is usually set to ‘BIDS’

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Target Sub ID N Assigned Subid

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Poss Resend N BIDS Trading will see if the conditional or firm order has already been received and processed, and ignore it if it already has. Value is always ‘Y’

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: On Behalf Of Comp ID N Trading partner company ID. Optionally provided by a routing service (e.g. an EMS) to identify the originating company.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: On Behalf Of Sub ID N Trading partner Sub ID. Optionally provided by a routing service (e.g. an EMS) to identify the originating Sub ID. May be used in lieu of tag 50 to provide a known BIDS Trading OMS/EMS user.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Orig Sending Time N Required for message resent as a result of a Resend Request. If data is not available set to same value as Sending Time

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Deliver To Comp ID N BIDS Trading will use it as the routing destination If specified, it must be a BIDS recognized external execution venue (i.e) SMAEBXL) or the keyword “None”. Defaultable

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. Always unencrypted, always last field in message.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Account mnemonic as agreed between buy and sell sides.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Calculated average price of all fills on this order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by firm. Must be <= 30 characters

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Symbol’s base currency. Sending of this tag or not is configurable.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Total quantity (e.g. number of shares) filled.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of each Execution Report message.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Provided for Ord Type=P

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Reference identifier used with Cancel transaction types Provided in Trade Cancellation

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New 1 = Cancel ( when a trade cancellation occurs)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Sending of this tag is configurable, and can be one of: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Market of execution for last fill. Provided on Fill/Partially Fill (Ord Status tag39 = 1/2).

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Includes BIDSOrder Id and oms Sequence No

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity ordered.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Identifies current status of order. 0 = New 1 = Partially filled 2 = Filled 4 = Cancelled 5 = Replaced C = Expired

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: On of the following: 1 = Market 2 = Limit P = Pegged (requires Exec Inst)

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price per unit of quantity.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Order Capacity

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: Sending of this tag is configurable, and is set to the ISIN or RIC of the security, dependent on the IDSource type (tag 22) chosen.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Only 1=Buy, 2=Sell and 5=Sell Short are currently supported

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Either a listed or OTC instrument.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time in force 0 = Day Order 3 = IOC – Immediate or Cancel 6 = GTD – Good til Date (requires use of Expire Time (tag 126)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the transaction represented by this Execution Report occurred

Field.Name: SymbolSfx
Field.Description: Depends on gateway configuration, it can with dot or without dot, or not present

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Used if the submitted order is being submitted for another broker

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Mnemonic used to identify the sponsored user to the sponsoring broker.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity of an order to be executed.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Always set to N if Locate Info is provided

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Order expiration time (required if Time In Force (tag 59) = 6 (GTD))

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Describes the type of execution report. 0 = New 1 = Partial fill 2 = Fill 4 = Cancelled 5 = Replace C = Expired

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity open for further execution. Leaves Qty = Order Qty (38) – Cum Qty (14).

Field.Name: EffectiveTime
Field.Description: Time the details within the message should take effect.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Sending of this tag is configurable, and is set to the Listing market of the security. This follows the FIX 4.4 style MIC code

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Amount (signed) added to the price of the peg Provided on Pegged Order

Field.Name: DiscretionInst
Field.Description: Code to identify the price a Discretion Offset is related to and should be mathematically added to. Required if Discretion Offset is specified. Valid value: 0 – Related to the display price

Field.Name: DiscretionOffset
Field.Description: The amount added to the limit price – Price (tag 44). Discretion Offset can be either negative or positive. Discretionary price = Price (tag 44) + Discretion Offset (tag 389) For Sell orders the Discretion Offset should be negative

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: In the case of Give up the MPID for the give up Clearing Firm.

Field.Name: PartyID
Field.Description: Required if No Party IDs(453) > 0. Identification of the party.

Field.Name: PartyIDSource
Field.Description: Required if No Party IDs(453) > 0. Used to identify classification source. N = Legal Entity Identifier (ISO 17442) LEI

Field.Name: PartyRole
Field.Description: Required if No Party IDs(453) > 0. Identifies the type or role of the Party ID (448) specified. 13 = Order Origination Firm

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Capacity of Firm placing order. If set to Riskless Principal tag 47 will be set to ‘A’

Field.Name: TrdRegTimestamp
Field.Description: Time the trade occurred at the trading venue.

Field.Name: BookingType
Field.Description: Method used for booking, used to notify a broker that the Firm-up is to be booked out as a Contract for Difference (CFD). 0 = Cash/Regular 1 = Contract for Difference (CFD)

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether fill was result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking liquidity Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: RegulatoryTradeID
Field.Description: Populated if the trade was done by an external venue. Uniquely identifies the trade by theexternal venue where the trade was done. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2).

Field.Name: RegulatoryTradeIDType
Field.Description: Indicates the type of trade identifier provided in Regulatory Trade ID. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2). 5=Trading venue transaction identification

Field.Name: NoRegulatoryTradeIDs
Field.Description: Number of regulatory IDs in the repeating group. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2).

Field.Name: LocateBroker
Field.Description: FINRA rule 3370 (Short Sell Rule) requires that every short sell order specify a Locate (Tag 114=Y), identifying which broker has loaned the stock to settle the short sale

Field.Name: LocateIdentifier
Field.Description: The actual locate identifier/reference provided by the Locate Broker (5700).

Field.Name: BIDSPriceProtection
Field.Description: Indicates the trader’s willingness to trade inside NBBO or not.

Field.Name: TradingVenueRegulatoryTradeID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the trade. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2).

Field.Name: BIDSTradeId
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the trade. Provided on Fill/Partially Fill (Ord Status tag39 = 1/2).

Field.Name: BIDSReportingType
Field.Description: Indicate the type of drop copy execution

Field.Name: BIDSUniqueClOrdID
Field.Description: Combine Cl Ord ID(tag11) with source gateway ID to make a unique Cl Ord ID

Field.Name: BIDSSponsoredTraderName
Field.Description: Sponsored trader’s real name in the form of <first name>.<last name> Provided if gateway is configured to include sponsored trader name in the drops This is only available for report version 1.3 or higher.

Field.Name: BIDSCentralCounterparty
Field.Description: The CCP handling the trade. Provided on IOIFilled.

Field.Name: TargetContraFirm
Field.Description: Depends on gateway setting, contra firm (the firm on the other side of the trade) is reported in either tag375 or tag8070. Applies to AIOI Workflow (AWF) trades only. Provided on Fill/Partially Fill (Ord Status tag39 = 1/2).

Field.Name: BIDSAEFirm
Field.Description: Indicates the Firm

Field.Name: BIDSAEVolume
Field.Description: Quantity of Allotment.

Field.Name: BIDSAEBookingType
Field.Description: Method used for booking, used to notify a broker that the Allotment is to be booked out as a Contract for Difference (CFD). 0 = Cash/Regular 1 = Contract for Difference (CFD)

Field.Name: BIDSAEFilledVolume
Field.Description: Quantity of shares bought/sold on this (last) fill for this Allotment. Not present on New, Cancelled, Replace, Expire

Field.Name: PartyIDOrderOriginationFirm
Field.Description: LEI of Order Origination Firm. It is a configurable setting.

Field.Name: LEI_OrderOrigination
Field.Description: Identify the type of customer sending the order.

Field.Name: LEI_RoutingArrangementIndicator
Field.Description: Routing arrangement is in place (1 or 0, meaning yes or no, respectively).

Field.Name: UMIRRegulationID
Field.Description: SS = Significant Shareholder IA = Insider

Field.Name: PrincipalTrade
Field.Description: Present on executions where Broker executed a Principal trade. If present, value is Y. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: WashTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Indicates a wash trade. Y = wash trade Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: ProgramTrade
Field.Description: Identify this order as part of a program trade (Y or N).

Field.Name: Anonymous
Field.Description: Anonymize this order when trade reporting (Y or N).

Field.Name: RegulationID
Field.Description: Does not affect order handling but is reported to feeds.

Field.Name: NoTradeFeat
Field.Description: Defines how to prevent a self-trade.

Field.Name: NoTradeKey
Field.Description: Identifier for self-trade prevention.

Field.Name: ShortMarkingExempt
Field.Description: Used by regulators to identify directional neutral accounts.

Field.Name: BIDSOriginatingBroker
Field.Description: Broker on whose behalf this order is being submitted if different than the executing broker.

Field.Name: BIDSExecBroker
Field.Description: Executing broker.

Field.Name: BIDSContraExecBroker
Field.Description: Contra executing broker (the broker on the other side of the trade). Provided in Order Filled(tag150=1/2) only.

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Fee code associated with an execution. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: PrintFeeCode
Field.Description: Fee code associated with an execution that is printed back to the customer. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: LEI_CustomerAccount
Field.Description: Account number for clients not eligible to obtain an LEI.

Field.Name: LEI_AlgorithmID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the end-client orders automatically generated on a predetermined basis.

Field.Name: CustomerLEI
Field.Description: LEI for clients eligible to obtain an LEI including LEI of the foreign dealer equivalent (Encryption Required).

Field.Name: BrokerLEI
Field.Description: Non-PO IIROC Dealer Member (Correspondent Broker).

Field.Name: TraderID
Field.Description: Identifies the broker trader responsible for the order.

Field.Name: LastCapacity
Field.Description: Broker capacity in order execution. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2). Valid values: 1 = Agent 2 = Cross as agent 3 = Cross as principal 4 = Principal 5 = Mixed 6 = Cross as Mixed

Field.Name: ClientCrossRef
Field.Description: Can be used to provide additional client side cross reference information. Max length is 15 characters.

Field.Name: ShortSellNakedQty
Field.Description: For a short sell order, this field defines the portion of order quantity that is naked. It is assumed 0 if it is not specified with a short sell order. For non-short sell order, this field is not included.

Field.Name: ShortSellCoveredQty
Field.Description: For a short sell order, this field defines the portion of order quantity that is covered. It is assumed 0 if it is not specified with a short sell order. For non-short sell order, this field is not included.

Field.Name: ShortSellLongQty
Field.Description: For a short sell order, this field defines the portion of order quantity that is owned by the participant who places the order. It is assumed 0 if it is not specified with a short sell order. For non-short sell order, this field is not included. The sum of Short Sell Naked Qty, Short Sell Covered Qty and Short Sell Long Qty should equal to the Order Qty for a short sell order. The Short Sell Long Qty itself should not be equal to the Order Qty.

Field.Name: TransactID
Field.Description: A unique identifier assigned by CBOE Australia for each trade that can be cross referenced against CHESS messaging for post trade processing. It contains 10 characters in the format XXXXYYYYYY where X = the Serial Trade Qualifier and Y = the Trade Serial Number. The first character of the Serial Trade Qualifier identifies the trading venue. CHESS has allocated “C” to identify CBOE Australia trades. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: OriginOfTrans
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Origin of Order e.g. ACN, ABN, CHESS HIN, or other internal client identifier. Max 20 characters.

Field.Name: IntermediaryID
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field for Intermediary Identifier – may be populated with AFS licence number. Max 10 characters.

Field.Name: DirectedWholesaleIndic
Field.Description: Market Integrity Rule defined field to identify wholesale client Y/N value. Default = N

Field.Name: RemoveCrossingFromClearing
Field.Description: Boolean field that instructs BIDS not to send a crossing to the clearing house.

Field.Name: OrderRestrictions
Field.Description: Broker Preferencing logic can ONLY be enabled/disabled by contacting Market Operations to request that it be configured as a default setting on a per FIX Gateway basis. If a participant elects to have broker preferencing enabled, this tag <8182> permits the default setting to be overridden. I = Override broker preference default setting

Field.Name: CrossType
Field.Description: Defines the matching logic applied for this trade if it was an on-market crossing. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2). Valid values are: 101 = trade was the result of a broker preferenced crossing 102 = other

Field.Name: CashMargin
Field.Description: “1” = Cash Absence of this field indicates Cash order.

Field.Name: BIDSNBBPrice
Field.Description: Bid Price.

Field.Name: BIDSNBOPrice
Field.Description: Ask Price.

Field.Name: BIDSNBBOTimestamp
Field.Description: Time of the NBBO.

Field.Name: PrimaryLastPx
Field.Description: Primary exchange last traded price at the time of fill. Provided on Fill/Partial Fill (Ord Status tag 39 = 1 /2)

Field.Name: OrderClassification
Field.Description: Specify the Order Classification. Supported values: 1 = Non Low Latency Trading (Auto) 2 = Non Low Latency Trading (Manual) 3 = Market Making Strategy 4 = Arbitrage Strategy 5 = Directional Strategy 6 = Other Strategy

Field.Name: ToSTNeTOrderID
Field.Description: Order Acceptance Number in To STNe T Provided in Order Filled(tag150=1/2) only.

Field.Name: ToSTNeTExecutionID
Field.Description: Execution Notice number in To STNe T Provided in Order Filled(tag150=1/2) only.

Field.Name: ToSTNeTTransactTime
Field.Description: Transaction time in To STNe T Provided in Order Filled(tag150=1/2) only.

Field.Name: NoSelfTrade
Field.Description: Identified as Self-Trade Prevention (STP) order. Orders from the same participant with the same No Self Trade key will not be allowed to match with each other.

Field.Name: NoPartyIDs
Field.Description: Number of Party ID (448), Party IDSource (447), and Party Role (452) entries

Field.Name: SenderTime
Field.Description: Time the transction is sent. Dependant on gateway setting

Field.Name: NoBIDSAllotmentEntities
Field.Description: Number of Allotment Entities in the

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares bought/sold on this (last) fill. Assign to 0 on New, Cancelled, Replace, Expire

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill. Assign to 0 on New, Cancelled, Replace, Expire

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Depends on gateway setting, contra (the firm or broker) on the other side of the trade) is reported. Applies to AIOI Workflow (AWF) trades only. Provided on Fill/Partially Fill (Ord Status tag39 = 1/2).

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares bought/sold on this (last) fill. Assign to 0 on New, Cancelled, Replace, Expire

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this (last) fill. Assign to 0 on New, Cancelled, Replace, Expire

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Depends on gateway setting, contra (the firm or broker) on the other side of the trade) is reported. Applies to AIOI Workflow (AWF) trades only. Provided on Fill/Partially Fill (Ord Status tag39 = 1/2).

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades on attributed orders. Always 1 if present.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the previous order when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord ID of the previous order when canceling or replacing an order.

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Only used when Exec Type is Rejected (8). 0 = Exchange option 1 = Unknown symbol 2 = Exchange closed 3 = Order exceeds limit 5 = Unknown order 6 = Duplicate order 8 = Stale order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text string.

Value.Description: GTD – Good til Date (requires use of Expire Time (tag 126)
